description: Simulates acoustic spaces to add realistic reverberation to instruments.

parameters.name: MID / SIDE
parameters.description: Processes either the mid (summed mono) or side (stereo field) components of the input signal.
tips: Use Side mode to add width without muddying the center channel.

parameters.name: H.CUT
parameters.label: High Cut
parameters.description: Removes high frequencies from the reverb input.
tips: Cut highs to push the reverb further back in the mix.

parameters.name: L.CUT
parameters.label: Low Cut
parameters.description: Removes low frequencies from the reverb input.
tips: Essential for removing mud. Try cutting up to 300-500Hz on vocals.

parameters.name: DELAY
parameters.label: Predelay
parameters.description: Controls the delay between the direct signal and the first reverb reflection.
tips: Increase to separate the dry vocal from the reverb tail.
Tempo-synced delays can create rhythmic pumping effects.

parameters.name: SIZE
parameters.label: Room Size
parameters.description: Sets the size of the simulated virtual room.

parameters.name: DIFF
parameters.label: Diffusion
tips: Low = distinct echoes (grainy), High = smooth wash (dense).

parameters.name: MOD
parameters.label: Modulation Depth
parameters.description: Modulates the reverb time to smooth out metallic ringing.
tips: Adds chorus-like movement to the tail.
Use sparingly on realistic acoustic instruments.

parameters.name: SPEED
parameters.label: Modulation Speed
parameters.description: Sets the speed of the sine-wave modulation.

parameters.name: BASS
parameters.label: Bass Multiplier
parameters.description: Adjusts the decay time of bass frequencies relative to the main decay.
tips: Boost for boomy, dark rooms. Cut for tighter low end.

parameters.name: CROSS
parameters.label: Bass Crossover
parameters.description: Determines the frequency point below which bass is boosted by the Bass knob.

parameters.name: DEC
parameters.label: Decay Time
tips: Short (<1s) for ambience, Long (>2s) for lush tails.

parameters.name: DAMP
parameters.label: High Damping
parameters.description: Adjusts the damping rate of high frequencies in the tail.
tips: High damping = warm, dark room (absorptive walls).
Low damping = bright, splashing room (reflective walls).

parameters.name: DRY
parameters.label: Dry Level
parameters.description: Sets the level of the direct input signal.
tips: Set to 0 when using as a Send effect.

parameters.name: ER
parameters.label: Early Reflections
parameters.description: Sets the level of the first reflections.
tips: ER defines the 'position' in the room. louder ER = closer to walls/listener.

parameters.name: WET
parameters.label: Wet Level
parameters.description: Sets the level of the reverberant signal.

parameters.name: SEP
parameters.label: Stereo Separation
parameters.description: Adjusts the stereo separation of the wet reverb signal.
tips: Turn left for mono reverb, right for extra wide.

common_problems.solution: Increase L.CUT (Low Cut) to remove bass from the reverb.
Reduce DECAY time or WET level. Increase PREDELAY.
